title: Basic Shop
body:
# Basic Shop

**Basic Shop** is a lightweight and customizable admin shop plugin designed to be simple for admins to setup and players to use.

## Features

- GUI based.
- Easy to setup.
- Quicksell features. Either with GUI or commands.
- Command customization. **WIP**
- Analytics **WIP**

## Showcase
![BasicShop plugin miner category showing tooltip of an item displaying buying and selling options](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DEMpNktW/images/82452bbbeae79b990764d4e5a2c1bb689385e4a7.png)

## Version

Tested on 
- 1.21.11 Paper
- 26.1.2 Folia

By design, new minecraft versions should be automatically supported without updating the plugin.

## Dependencies
Vault and an economy plugin for money.

## Suggestions

Have an idea to improve **BasicShop**? Post them in our [GitHub](https://github.com/UsainSrht/BasicShop/issues).

## Bugs & Issues

If you encounter any bugs, please report them on [GitHub](https://github.com/UsainSrht/BasicShop/issues).
